title: Verify: Vite config proxies /api to the backend unit tests
summary: Unit test the dev proxy setting
description: Extend the node-environment viteConfig test to assert the proxy and that existing settings are kept.

steps.action: Add a describe block with an it that reads config.server?.proxy and asserts the '/api' entry targets http://localhost:8080 (matching backend/configs server.addr ':8080'), and a second it that asserts config.server?.fs?.allow equals ['..'].
steps.code:
const proxy = config.server?.proxy as Record<string, { target: string }>;
expect(proxy['/api'].target).toBe('http://localhost:8080');
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/viteConfig.test.ts
steps.expected: Both new tests and the publicDir test pass.
